name: venndor
description: A pragmatic CLI tool designed to cleanly inline Node dependencies directly into a `vendor/` directory in your repository. It acts exactly like standard workspace management but gives you total ownership over the raw source code of the dependencies you pull.
features: Built a high-performance CLI tool to securely vendor npm packages directly into a repository as owned source code.
Engineered intelligent package manager detection and non-destructive AST manipulations to seamlessly integrate with native workspace configurations.
Implemented robust offline Diff & Patch generation enabling developers to commit local hacks/fixes that automatically re-apply over upstream version bumps.
